column1: # Corpus lint findings that stay in rules/ and adapter testdata fixtures.
# path (from the module root), check, detail, and reason, tab-separated.
# TestFixtureTrees fails on a finding with no line here and on a line
# that matches no finding, and allowlistCeiling in corpus_test.go must
# equal the line count, so the list only shrinks. Secret and
# fetch-exec findings can never be listed; ParseAllowlist rejects them.
# rule-dependent: the rule needs this value. TC-CFG-009, 012, 015 and
#   023 match on real hosts; TC-CFG-001 and 008 test loopback
#   127.0.0.1 and ::1; TC-CFG-016 hashes the embed's bootstrap.sh;
#   TC-CFG-015 lists pastebin.com; TC-CFG-009 pins a 40-hex commit;
#   TC-CFG-001 nests bash -c past eight levels, which is the size.
# cosmetic, see #43 item 116: a real host or shebang the rule does not
#   need, or a UUID-shaped session id in a hook payload. Rewriting it
#   changes goldens, so it waits for that item.
# golden size: the golden is the adapter's discover output over its
#   whole fixture repository; splitting it regenerates the golden.
#   Accepted only for a path ending in .golden.
